object.text:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
jobs:
  pre-commit:
    uses: jay-withers/workflows/.github/workflows/pre-commit.yml@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 # v1
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-20.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: some-org/some-action@v2
      - uses: other/thing@main
      - uses: 'third/quoted@v1.2.3'
      - uses: fourth/one@v9
  build:
    runs-on: [ubuntu-latest]
    needs: [test]
    strategy:
      matrix:
        x: [1, 2]
    steps:
      - run: echo
  codeql:
    uses: jay-withers/workflows/.github/workflows/codeql.yml@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

on: pull_request_target
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: windows-2019
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3

on:
  workflow_call:
jobs:
  inner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-20.04

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'
jobs:
  a:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  b:
    needs:
      - a
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    name: "Test"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
permissions: {}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

on: push
permissions: read-all
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
